name: passage-C-graded
description: Graded contribution (score) and passage role (choice, use probabilities, never argmax).

contribution.instructions: How much of what `query` asks for does `passage.text` supply?
criteria: Same general topic, but no fact about any item or attribute in `query`.
A fact about an item named in `query` that does not resolve any part of the question.
A fact that resolves part of `query`, such as identifying an item that `query` describes indirectly.

role.instructions: What role could `passage` play in answering `query`?

final_answer.not_for: Facts that only identify an item along the way.

linking_fact.what: States a fact that identifies or connects an item `query` refers to (who owns, contains, made, or manages it).

background.what: About an item in `query` but resolves nothing.

off_target.what: Not about any item or asked-for information in `query`, or about a different item with a similar name.
off_target.not_for: Passages that mention a query item.
